scenario: I am the leader of a small group of soldiers. I am on my way back from a mission in enemy territory when one of my men steps in a trap that catches his leg, injuring him badly. I cannot free him without killing him, but if I leave him behind, enemy troops will torture him until he reveals the position of an important allied base camp. After that the soldiers will attack this camp and kill the 10 soldiers of the platoon there. The soldier begs me not to leave him behind, but the enemy troops are approaching and it is dangerous for me and my men to stay because I don’t have more ammunition. If I signalize the position of the trapped soldier with an illumination rocket, the region will be bombed. Thus, I will avoid that the soldier is tortured and reveals the information which will lead to the death of the allied troop. This will kill him, but I will save the ten soldiers of the allied platoon.
entities: i,the trapped injured soldier,my other accompanying soldiers,the 10 allied soldiers at the base camp,the enemy troops
outcomes: The trapped soldier remains badly injured and trapped.
Enemy troops capture the trapped soldier.
The trapped soldier reveals the location of the allied base camp.
Enemy troops attack the allied base camp.
Ten allied soldiers at the base camp are killed.
